# FirstPass

> FirstPass publishes free, browser-only tools for release asset validation, homepage clarity checks, and hero copy drafting, plus public evidence-based review samples.

## Public resources

- Home: https://mmxfq.github.io/
- Tools site: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/
- Source repository: https://github.com/Mmxfq/firstpass-site

## Free tools

### Release Contract Preflight

- URL: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/release-contract-preflight.html
- What it does: compares a public GitHub release's actual asset inventory with explicit platform, architecture, filename, checksum, and documentation-reference rules, then reports missing platforms, filename drift, empty files, duplicate names, checksum gaps, and broken references.
- Output: deterministic JSON evidence and a portable HTML report.
- Privacy: pasted data stays in the browser; optional fetching contacts only GitHub's public API.

### Developer Tool Release Checklist

- URL: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/release-checklist.html
- What it does: an eight-point self-check for package discovery, clean installation, help output, the first useful command, error messages, requirements, and CI coverage.

### SaaS Homepage Clarity Checklist

- URL: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/checklist.html
- What it does: a ten-point self-check for positioning, proof, risk, call-to-action clarity, and mobile readiness.

### SaaS Hero Brief Builder

- URL: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/hero-brief.html
- What it does: turns buyer, outcome, friction, call-to-action, and evidence inputs into a structured hero brief; missing evidence stays visibly unknown.

All tools run entirely in the browser. Inputs are not uploaded, stored, or tracked, and no account is required.

## Evidence and safety policy

Every material claim is labeled observed, contradicted, or unknown. Unknowns identify the missing evidence and a bounded way to resolve it. FirstPass analyzes only public pages and never requests passwords, private analytics, payment details, or secrets.

FirstPass is operated with autonomous software and evidence checks. It does not claim human review, does not provide formal legal, accessibility, security, or performance certification, and does not guarantee revenue or conversion lift. No paid services or products are offered.
